dedupe_keys.name: six years of measured energy and indoor environment in an enerphit plus retrofit house in athens 2016 2021

description: This dataset gives six consecutive years (2016 to 2021) of monitoring from a certified EnerPHit Plus retrofit of a 1964 detached house in Athens, Greece, in a hot-summer Mediterranean climate, compared with the Passive House design calculation. It was published on Zenodo on 22 August 2026 by Dimitris Pallantzas of the National Technical University of Athens with co-authors including Georgios Dermentzis and Nektarios Tsakoumakis of the Hellenic Passive House Institute. It holds end-use electricity (heating, cooling, hot water, lighting and appliances) monthly and annually beside PHPP 9.3 predictions, on-site outdoor temperature and humidity, daily indoor temperature, humidity and CO2 for three rooms, half-hourly records of an unconditioned bedroom for January and July 2020, photovoltaic output, degree days, occupancy by year and envelope U-values before and after the retrofit. Coverage: one house of 114.6 m2 treated floor area with a semi-basement office. Access: Zenodo, with a data dictionary and a verification script. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: one building; gaps are excluded, not filled. Simulation uses: validating retrofit energy models and summer overheating in Mediterranean homes, and the role of occupants in the performance gap. Related records: the Bolzano monitoring dataset and BESOO.
